T1.implementation_approach: Use a component-based design approach with a focus on user experience and accessibility. Create wireframes and prototypes before finalizing the design.
T1.notes: Ensure the UI is responsive and supports search and filtering of problems.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle CRUD operations for problems. Implement authentication and authorization for secure access.
T2.notes: Focus on scalability and ensure proper error handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Design a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata. Normalize the schema to avoid redundancy.
T3.notes: Consider indexing frequently queried fields for performance.

T4.implementation_approach: Create an intuitive interface for users to write and submit code. Include syntax highlighting and error feedback.
T4.notes: Ensure the editor supports multiple programming languages.

T5.implementation_approach: Implement a sandboxed environment to execute user-submitted code securely. Compare outputs with expected results.
T5.notes: Focus on security to prevent malicious code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up a distributed system using containers to handle code evaluation at scale. Use a message queue for task distribution.
T6.notes: Ensure the system is fault-tolerant and scalable.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly profile page displaying user details, progress, and achievements.
T7.notes: Include options for users to edit their profile information.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage user profiles, including CRUD operations and progress tracking.
T8.notes: Ensure data consistency and implement proper validation.

T9.implementation_approach: Create a leaderboard interface that displays user rankings and supports sorting and filtering.
T9.notes: Optimize for real-time updates and large datasets.

T10.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to calculate and fetch leaderboard rankings based on user performance metrics.
T10.notes: Use caching for frequently accessed leaderboard data.

T11.implementation_approach: Design an interface to display hints and tutorials for problems. Include collapsible sections for better readability.
T11.notes: Ensure the UI is accessible and supports multimedia content.

T12.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage hints and tutorials, including CRUD operations and content retrieval.
T12.notes: Implement version control for tutorial content.

T13.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests to verify the functionality of the problem library. Use mock data for testing.
T13.notes: Focus on edge cases and performance testing.

T14.implementation_approach: Simulate code submissions and evaluate the correctness and performance of the evaluation system.
T14.notes: Test for security vulnerabilities and edge cases.

T15.implementation_approach: Verify the functionality of user profiles, including progress tracking and data consistency.
T15.notes: Ensure proper handling of concurrent updates.

T16.implementation_approach: Test the leaderboard functionality for accuracy, performance, and real-time updates.
T16.notes: Simulate large datasets to test scalability.

T17.implementation_approach: Test the hints and tutorials system for content accuracy, accessibility, and multimedia support.
T17.notes: Ensure compatibility with different devices and browsers.
